PORT.description: Port the container listens on (mapped to OPENBB_API_PORT by the entrypoint).

OPENBB_API_AUTH.description: Enable HTTP Basic auth on the endpoints (true/false). false = open access on a private project.

OPENBB_API_USERNAME.description: Basic-auth username (only used when OPENBB_API_AUTH=true). Auto-filled so you can deploy one-click and change it later.

OPENBB_API_PASSWORD.description: Basic-auth password (only used when OPENBB_API_AUTH=true). Auto-generated on deploy; change it from the Variables tab.

FMP_API_KEY.description: Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) key — premium equity/ETF/FX. Paste your key to enable FMP calls; leave empty to use keyless providers (yfinance) and add it later from the Variables tab. Get one: https://site.financialmodelingprep.com/developer/docs.

INTRINIO_API_KEY.description: Intrinio key — fundamentals & market data. Paste your key to enable Intrinio calls; leave empty and add it later from the Variables tab.

FRED_API_KEY.description: FRED (St. Louis Fed, free) key — macro/economic series (CPI, GDP series, rate curves). Paste your key to enable FRED calls; leave empty and add it later. Free tier: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/api_key.html.
